tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Permission-filtered hybrid search across Docs, Pages, and Stickies with heading-anchored snippets.

query.description: Lexical or semantic search query (1..500 chars)

kinds.description: Entity kinds to search (default: [doc, page, sticky])

project.description: Optional project identifier or UUID scope filter

limit.description: Max search hits to return (1..50, default 20)

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from previous search

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read a Doc, Page, or Sticky in canonical Markdown with progressive LOD disclosure.

identifier.description: Page path, doc key, doc/page/sticky UUID, or 'help'

lod.description: Level of detail: summary, standard, or full

tools.name: upsert_doc
tools.description: Create or update hierarchical Docs/Pages in canonical Markdown with section patching.

identifier.description: Existing doc/page canonical key, path, or UUID to update; omit to create

parent.description: Parent doc key or page path when creating a child page

title.description: Document or page display title (1..200 characters)

mode.description: Content update mode: replace, append, or section_patch

section_heading.description: Case-sensitive target ATX heading required when mode=section_patch

if_match.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 ETag required for concurrency control on update

tools.name: manage_stickies
tools.description: Manage Project Stickies: list, create, edit, recolor, and inspect promotion recommendation.

project.description: Project key or UUID (required except for action='help')

sticky.description: Sticky UUID for edit or recolor

tools.name: promote_sticky_to_doc
tools.description: Atomically promote a complex Sticky into a permanent Doc, preserving ACLs and creating PROMOTED_TO_DOC link.

sticky.description: UUID of the sticky note to promote

parent.description: Optional parent doc key, page path, or UUID to promote into as a page

title.description: Optional display title for the promoted document

tools.name: link_knowledge
tools.description: Connect Docs, Pages, or Stickies to Issues, Cycles, Modules, or Projects with typed object links.

source.description: Source doc key, page path, or sticky UUID

target.description: Target issue key, cycle ref, module ref, or project key

action.description: Action: add or remove the link
